title: The Asking to Try the Whisk
youtube_title: The Asking to Try the Whisk | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Courage can be a small voice used at the right moment.
summary: At a small school room with a low stage edge, Quinn feels shy about asking to try the whisk. Instead of pretending not to care, Quinn tries the smallest brave version in a voice that can be heard, while Mama stays kind and does not push for a show.
